verdict.rationale: The features page lists "Digital offer letters & eSignatures" as a marketed capability, but there is no documentation of templated offer letters with dynamic fields, approval routing workflows, or details on the e-signature implementation—only a single marketing bullet point. Missing for 10: documentation of dynamic-field templating, approval routing/workflow configuration, e-signature vendor/integration details, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of the feature actually working.
